rawContent: Transport for the South East are consulting on their new strategy. Transport is the UK's biggest source of climate-wrecking emissions, so I’ve used @friends_earth’s tool to tell them to do more for the #ClimateEmergency and public health. Will you join me? https://t.co/YTgs05SUmV

How climate-friendly is your community? @friends_earth has collected data about how areas across the country perform on key issues impacting our climate. How does your area measures up? #TakeClimateAction #ClimateEmergency.  https://t.co/XUjX6FWCrp
